build_delayed_pattern: build a DelayedPatternProvider to interleave multi-codebook sequences with per-codebook delays
build_parallel_pattern: build a ParallelPatternProvider to interleave multi-codebook sequences with no delay between codebooks
build_unrolled_pattern: build an UnrolledPatternProvider to flatten and unroll codebooks with configurable inner steps and delays
build_coarse_first_pattern: build a CoarseFirstPattern provider to generate coarse codebooks first then remaining ones with delays
build_musiclm_pattern: build a MusicLMPattern provider to generate codebooks in grouped MusicLM-style order
